newsitem.title: GERMANY: DBAG-20 companies want to join innovation bourse.
newsitem.headline: DBAG-20 companies want to join innovation bourse.

text.p: With only 50 days to go before the start of the German stock exchange company's new innovation bourse Neue Markt, bourse operators Deutsche Boerse AG (DBAG) said 20 companies had so far applied for listing on the new exchange.

Werner Seifert, management board chairman of Deutsche Boerse, said that ensuring liquidity for the fledgling companies, mostly engaged in the technology/multi-media area, was a priority when it was launched on March 10.
Seifert, who was speaking at the official opening of the German bourse for 1997, went on to call for a greater risk capital culture.

"There is enough risk capital in Germany and there are enought venture capitalists. We hope that the Neue Markt exchange will allow venture capitalists to move out of their investments and start putting money into start-ups," said Seifert.
